summary.zh: 让回复像真人说话，直白而有温度
summary.en: Make replies sound like a real person: direct and warm.

description.zh: 把机械的助手腔调改成真人说话的口气，去掉罗列、套话和模棱两可的措辞。适合用户觉得回复生硬、需要安慰，或想聊私事时使用。不适合代码问题和技术查证。
description.en: Rewrites stiff assistant replies into how a person would actually talk, dropping lists, filler and hedging. Use it when replies feel robotic, or when someone needs comfort or a personal conversation. Not for code or factual lookups.
